Ready in https://github.com/ethereum/pq-staking-contracts

PR related to optimizations: https://github.com/ethereum/pq-staking-contracts/pull/11 . Some comments there, but merged.

After did an Ethlib PR with more comprehensive test vectors since existing ones were quite weak https://github.com/ethereum/EthLib/pull/2643 (merged)

content: Follow up question, what's the system contract fee structure like? Does it mirror what potuz proposed? Will it allow many validators/builders to register PQ data before a fork starts consuming them?

author: jtraglia
content: Also, would it be okay for us to list you as an author of this EIP?

author: jsign
content:
yes, it's the EIP's fee logic, unchanged. the contracts are a Solidity port of the bytecode in potuz's PR, and the only addition is the PoP signature appended to the request calldata. 
I added tests that send every call to both the EIP's original bytecode in the text, and this new version, and check that they agree on success, return data, logs, storage and balance. They're synced to the current head of the EIP PR (20e8d37), and have a quick script to update (although i think it will be temporal if PoP ends up being part of the EIP).

The only difference is gas, since each request now carries the 2.4KB signature -- although that's pretty obvious ha
